import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_name} Invitation
{event_name}
Date: {date_of_event}
{description_of_event}
{notes_block}
""" def create_invitation_for_event( event_name: str, description_of_event: str, date_of_event: str, notes_for_event: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- event_name : str The title of the event. description_of_event : str Detailed description, may contain newlines and formatting. date_of_event : str Scheduled date for the event. notes_for_event : str Additional notes or instructions. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent injection esc_event_name = html.escape(event_name, quote=True) esc_description = html.escape(description_of_event, quote=True) esc_date = html.escape(date_of_event, quote=True) # Notes are optional; include only if provided if notes_for_event.strip(): esc_notes = html.escape(notes_for_event, quote=True) notes_block = f'
Notes:
{esc_notes}
' else: notes_block = '' # Render the template with sanitized values return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_name=esc_event_name, description_of_event=esc_description, date_of_event=esc_date, notes_block=notes_block )
